detail.issues: Both models have geometric distortions in the 3D views compared to the reference's square. Model A has more pronounced distortion in the bottom-left view, while Model B's distortions are slightly less extreme but still present in all views.
Model A has incorrect leaf patterns and a simplified base; Model B has distorted floral patterns and incorrect structural details.

Model A has incorrect base color (darker gray), lampshade color shift (darker magenta), and thin black cable. Model B has correct base color, but the cable is slightly thicker and less realistic than the reference's thin black cable.

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect color scheme (darker tones), missing screen texture details, and simplified control panel. Model B has incorrect color scheme (lighter tones), simplified control panel, and missing screen texture details.

Model A has incorrect side handles and a black back face; Model B has incorrect side latches and a dark brown back face, with both models having wrong back face colors and missing reference details like the small tab and loop.
